meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars 等常驻内核引擎和一次性工具分析你的数据文件,做分组、连接、聚合、时间序列、清洗,并在需要时画图。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据集,做分组聚合、时间序列或清洗画图时触发。

say.text: 用 DuckDB 查一下 data.csv 里每个城市的订单总数。
say.note: 直接查文件,不整表载入内存。

say.text: 这份 Parquet 超出内存,用 Polars 流式处理并按时间聚合。
say.note: 超内存时改走流式引擎。

say.text: 把这份数据的销售额分布画成图,并做一次视觉检查。
say.note: 按可视化参考选图并做视觉 QA。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your data files with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools: group-by, joins, aggregation, time series, cleaning, and charts when an answer is a shape.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to analyze a CSV, Parquet, or JSON dataset: group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting.

say_en.text: Query data.csv for order counts per city with DuckDB.
say_en.note: Queries the file in place, no full load.

say_en.text: This Parquet exceeds RAM — stream it with Polars and aggregate by time.
say_en.note: Streaming engine for data past RAM.

say_en.text: Plot the distribution of sales in this dataset, then check the chart.
say_en.note: Follows the visualization reference and visual QA.
